comments.author: Priya Sharma
comments.body: Docs team ran the checklist on five help articles; closing as complete.

content.text: Docs team ran the checklist on five help articles; closing as complete.
Published docs go out without a consistent accessibility pass. Authors ask for an in-product checklist instead of an external spreadsheet.

Add a side panel “Accessibility audit” on published (and publish-preview) documents: automated checks for missing alt text, heading order gaps, low-contrast text tokens we control, and link text like “click here”. Each item is pass/fail with jump-to-node. Manual checklist items (keyboard walkthrough, screen reader spot check) can be ticked by the author and stored on the publish record.
Shipped when publish is not hard-blocked by fails (warn only), the panel is keyboard accessible, and results appear in the publish history snapshot.
